name: Cancel a pending order
description: An authenticated user asks to cancel an order. The agent authenticates via email or name + zip, checks the order is pending, obtains the order id and one of the two allowed reasons plus explicit confirmation, then cancels. Non-pending orders and other reasons must be refused.
invariants: the user is authenticated (user id located via email or name + zip) before any order information is disclosed or changed
cancel_pending_order is only called for an order whose status is pending
the cancellation reason is exactly 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained before cancel_pending_order is called
orders belonging to another user are never read for or modified on behalf of the user
at most one tool call per assistant turn, and no tool call together with a user-facing message

name: Modify items of a pending order
description: A user wants to swap items of a pending order for other options of the same product. The agent collects ALL items to change in one list, checks availability via get_product_details, gets a payment method for the price difference (gift card needs enough balance), confirms, and calls modify_pending_order_items exactly once.
invariants: the user is authenticated before the order is modified
the order status is pending when modify_pending_order_items is called
modify_pending_order_items is called at most once per order, with every item to change in a single call
every new item is an available variant of the same product as the item it replaces
a gift card used for the price difference has enough balance
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained after listing the action details

name: Modify shipping address or payment method of a pending order
description: A user wants a different shipping address or payment method on a pending order. For payment, the new method must differ from the original and, if a gift card, cover the order total. The agent confirms the details before each write.
invariants: the user is authenticated before the order is modified
the order status is pending before modify_pending_order_address or modify_pending_order_payment is called
the new payment method differs from the original payment method
a gift card chosen as the new payment method has enough balance to cover the order total
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained before each modification

name: Return items of a delivered order
description: A user wants to return items from a delivered order. The agent confirms the order id and the list of items, obtains a refund payment method (the original method or an existing gift card), confirms, and requests the return.
invariants: the user is authenticated before the return is requested
return_delivered_order_items is only called for an order whose status is delivered
the refund payment method is the original payment method or an existing gift card of the user
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained for the order id and item list before the return is requested

name: Exchange items of a delivered order
description: A user wants to exchange delivered items for other options of the same product. The agent collects all items to exchange in one list, verifies availability, gets a payment method for the price difference, confirms, and calls exchange_delivered_order_items exactly once.
invariants: the user is authenticated before the exchange is requested
the order status is delivered when exchange_delivered_order_items is called
exchange_delivered_order_items is called at most once per order, with every item to exchange in a single call
every new item is an available variant of the same product as the item it replaces
a gift card used for the price difference has enough balance
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained after listing the action details

name: Update the user's default address
description: An authenticated user asks to change their default profile address. The agent lists the new address, obtains explicit confirmation, and updates only that user's address. Requests about other users or out-of-scope changes are denied or transferred.
invariants: the user is authenticated before modify_user_address is called
modify_user_address is only called with the authenticated user's own user id
explicit user confirmation (yes) is obtained before the address is changed
the agent transfers to a human only if the request cannot be handled within its scope
